/bin/bash -lc "cat > /tmp/dashboard-component-check/check.mjs <<'NODE'
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import React from 'react'
import { act, create } from 'react-test-renderer'
import Dashboard from './Dashboard.mjs'

globalThis.IS_REACT_ACT_ENVIRONMENT = true
const calls = []
globalThis.fetch = (url, options) => new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
  calls.push({ url, options, resolve, reject })
})

let renderer
await act(async () => { renderer = create(React.createElement(Dashboard)) })
assert.deepEqual(calls.map(({ url }) => url), ['/api/analytics', '/api/notifications', '/api/settings'])
assert.match(JSON.stringify(renderer.toJSON()), /Loading dashboard data/)
await act(async () => {
  calls[0].resolve(new Response(JSON.stringify({ views: 42 })))
  calls[1].resolve(new Response(JSON.stringify([{ message: 'Hello' }])))
  calls[2].resolve(new Response(JSON.stringify({ theme: 'dark' })))
})
const rendered = JSON.stringify(renderer.toJSON())
for (const value of ['Analytics', '42', 'Notifications', 'Hello', 'Settings', 'dark']) assert.ok(rendered.includes(value), value)
await act(async () => { renderer.unmount() })
assert.ok(calls.every(({ options }) => options.signal.aborted))

calls.length = 0
await act(async () => { renderer = create(React.createElement(Dashboard)) })
await act(async () => { calls[0].resolve(new Response('failed', { status: 500 })) })
assert.match(JSON.stringify(renderer.toJSON()), /Unable to load dashboard data/)
assert.ok(calls.every(({ options }) => options.signal.aborted))
await act(async () => { renderer.unmount() })
console.log('Dashboard behavior checks passed')
NODE
node /tmp/dashboard-component-check/check.mjs"
